strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道是电话⋯⋯坏了吗？{SCROLL}你从别的地方{NEWLINE}再打一个过来吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Hello? I can’t hear you very well...{NEWLINE}We must have a bad connection...{SCROLL}Try calling me again from a different{NEWLINE}location, please.

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯你近况如何？{NEWLINE}我精神可是好得很啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello... How are you?{NEWLINE}I’m doing well, thanks.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 除了我之外,{NEWLINE}很有许多厉害的训练师,{CLEAR}请你努力吧⋯⋯
strings.en: There are lots of other strong Trainers{NEWLINE}besides me... Please do your best...
strings.notes: US 0654/3 | RV071: meaning: no 'stronger than me' / 'challenge them' in zh

strings.zh: 对了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我在星期三的白天{CLEAR}有空闲的时间,{SCROLL}到时候你再打电话来吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Let’s see...{NEWLINE}I’m usually free on Wednesdays{CLEAR}around noon. I could spare some time...{SCROLL}Why don’t you call me again then...

strings.zh: 小明最近也是{NEWLINE}一副精神饱满的样子。{CLEAR}我也能得到{CLEAR}一些空闲时间了,{SCROLL}我们再来一场{NEWLINE}精灵对战怎么样？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Amphy’s been full of energy lately, too.{NEWLINE}I’ve also been able to take some time to{CLEAR}myself. What do you think? Would you{CLEAR}like to battle me again? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0654/5 | RV071: meaning: Amphy looks full of energy (not 'gotten better')

strings.zh: 我知道了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}那我在战斗前线的{CLEAR}训练家屋等你。
strings.en: I-I see...{NEWLINE}Then I’ll be waiting for you at the{CLEAR}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.
strings.notes: US 0654/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 啊呀？{SCROLL}在和我战斗之前{NEWLINE}你不是已经和{CLEAR}其他人预约过了吗？
strings.en: Huh?{SCROLL}Before you battle me again, don’t you{NEWLINE}have other appointments to keep?

strings.zh: 我知道了,那我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你,{CLEAR}届时请你手下留情啊。
strings.en: I understand. Then I’ll be{NEWLINE}waiting for you at the Trainer{CLEAR}House at the Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}Please go easy on me{NEWLINE}when the time comes...
strings.notes: US 0654/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我是蜜柑,{NEWLINE}听你声音好像精神不错嘛。{SCROLL}
strings.en: This is Jasmine.{NEWLINE}You sound like you’re doing well.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 难道你忘了{NEWLINE}和我对战的约定了么？{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的训练家屋{CLEAR}等你⋯⋯
strings.en: D-did you forget our promise to battle?{SCROLL}I’m waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier...
strings.notes: US 0654/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 那之后你去过{NEWLINE}浅葱市的灯塔了吗？{SCROLL}我最近也非常忙,{NEWLINE}所以去看小明的机会{CLEAR}也越来越少了⋯⋯{SCROLL}不过⋯⋯到了晚上,{NEWLINE}一看到灯塔的光,{CLEAR}我就会想{CLEAR}「小明,你要好起来啊」
strings.en: Have you been to the Olivine City{NEWLINE}Lighthouse since then? I’ve been so{CLEAR}busy myself lately, so I get fewer and{CLEAR}fewer chances to go see Amphy... But...{CLEAR}at night, whenever I see the{CLEAR}Lighthouse’s light, I think, “Amphy,{CLEAR}please get well...”
strings.notes: US 0654/12 | RV071: meaning: 'Amphy, get well' wish and Olivine City restored

strings.zh: 那个⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我有点事想问你,{CLEAR}你觉得我的道馆怎么样？{CLEAR}有没有感到什么奇怪的地方？{SCROLL}可是⋯⋯大家都说{NEWLINE}钢铁感觉好冷。{CLEAR}我觉得它好可怜⋯⋯
strings.en: Um...{NEWLINE}There’s something I wanted to{CLEAR}ask you. What did you think of my{CLEAR}Gym? Did anything seem strange?{SCROLL}It’s just... everyone says steel feels{NEWLINE}so cold. I feel a little sorry for it...

strings.zh: 狩猎场的巴奥巴⋯⋯{NEWLINE}也到我的道馆来{CLEAR}看了一下⋯⋯{SCROLL}那个人说话的{NEWLINE}感觉蛮奇怪的。{SCROLL}满口的土话⋯⋯
strings.en: Warden Baoba from the Safari Zone...{NEWLINE}came by to see my Gym, too...{SCROLL}The way he talks is a{NEWLINE}little strange, isn’t it?{SCROLL}Such a thick country accent...
